title: Why Movie Theater Popcorn Costs So Much
sentence: In the quarter to Sept. 30, 2026, AMC's film exhibition costs were about 50% of its admissions revenue, while its food and beverage costs were about 18% of food and beverage revenue (our calculation from AMC's 10-Q); in 2025 the average patron spent $12.09 on admissions and $7.62 on food and drinks.
source: AMC Entertainment Holdings, Form 10-Q for the quarter ended Sept. 30, 2026: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1411579/000141157926000075/amc-20260930x10q.htm
AMC Q4 2025 earnings call highlights (per-patron figures): https://finance.yahoo.com/news/amc-entertainment-holdings-inc-amc-050151905.html
